note: Chapter 18 (Average) starts at book p.598 (PDF p.601); its question pages run well past book p.612 (seen through at least Q221). Extremely repetitive within each sub-pattern (weighted/combined average of differently sized or ratio-weighted groups, backward-solving for a group's size/percentage from a combined average, replacement/removal changing a group's average, mean of an evenly-spaced run of numbers, mean of squares, consecutive-integer mean-is-the-middle-term, the classic 'overlapping day' average puzzle, and a cluster of pure algebraic average identities: shift by a constant, scale by a constant, sum of deviations is zero, combining two groups symbolically). 23 representative questions were kept (2-6 per sub-pattern) and filed into the existing average.py topic: two new PYQs for the pre-existing q-av-weighted and q-av-parts qtypes, plus five brand-new qtypes (q-av-backsolve, q-av-replace, q-av-series, q-av-squares, q-av-consec-mid, q-av-overlap, q-av-algebra). As with Chapter 17, no separate book answer-key table was located for the question range used here, so every answer was verified the primary way only: independently recomputed from the question's own numbers and checked to match exactly one of the four printed options.
